body:
@harshmaur can you provide a jsbin/small repo with a simplified example showing us the issue ?

In order to have the InstantSearch instance updated you need to pass a new `state` props. I assume that because the route is changing, then the `componentWillReceiveProps` of the component to render will be triggered. Then you need to parse the url to reconstruct the state, and use that state to update the InstantSearch instance.
